text: Very tasteful sourdough bread especially special menu such as mango sourdough, lemon jam and mango butter. Very recommend for sourdough lovers.

One of my favourite sourdough place. You have to pre-order and then pick up at the store. The sourdough flavour is changing every week. Today I got country batard, soft and sour, kinda original style. The sourdough is not that crusty, more fluffy. Kinda Japanese bread style. I like it though. Also, I got garlic butter. It creates a perfect combo with the sourdough. Slightly apply it on the bread and toasted. Lit!

Highly recommend.
I stumbled upon this shop in google map and appear in front of the house. Unexpectedly warm welcome from owner and feeling like bread sampling from a friend house.

So incredibly delicious! If you like sourdough that's hollow in the middle, not dense, this shop is perfect. Eating it with their cream cheese is amazing! 😭✨💋 The owner or the staff member is so lovely and easy to talk to, they let me sample everything! Aww 😍

Freshly baked sourdough, taking orders every week.
Light and airy texture, thin crust. Stop by and buy if we have some left, and if we have time, sometimes we offer samples.
The seller is lovely, attentive, and always smiling.
Purple sweet potato: 295 baht per piece.
Original: 280 baht per piece.

The entrance is a house gate. Turn around and follow the road, you'll find a beautiful baking studio on the left.

Freshly baked bread, easy and delicious to eat, even better when crispy. Priced at 200-300 baht per loaf.

The shop has good resources, including equipment, systems, location, and lovely staff, resulting in high-quality products and attentive service. It's definitely worth the money, although you might not want to eat it very often. It's an experience worth trying.
The sourdough bread is delicious, with a thin crust. I ordered it and picked it up at the store. They even offered samples! I sampled almost enough to fill me up!🤣 So lovely!🩷🩷 …
Bow is so lovely! She chatted with me and let me try her sourdough, which was incredibly delicious!

This isn't a cafe.
Just a house open for loaf orders and pick-up.
Nice loaf >>> The ham and cheese was yummy.
Quite hot shop, seems unair-conditioned.
Only one table with four chairs. 🥹

It looks like a house selling delicious loaf and delicious bread.
I tried it and liked it. The atmosphere is nice, but...
There aren't any tables to sit at. 🥹
There was only one table when we went, and a customer had already sat down, so we had to take it home.
The shop is hot, seems unair-conditioned.
I recommend ordering and taking it home.

It was so delicious! 💙🫨 I'll definitely order again.

I stumbled upon this charming bakery on Google Maps and was delighted to discover their exceptional homemade sourdough bread, along with delicious spreads of butter and jam.

I'd like to express my appreciation.
The service was excellent. Even though I couldn't buy any pastries because they were sold out, the vendor and staff had great service minds. They offered me a …

It's a bit hard to find the shop, located in Thanawal Village. One side of the gate is open, it looks more like someone's house than a shop, so I drove past it.
The sourdough has a soft crust, not a dense texture, and tastes good (Pesto Sourdough).

I found it by chance on Google and came without a reservation because I didn't know the place or its information. I had an appointment nearby, and luckily there was one left to buy. Thank you so much!
The sourdough was delicious. The owner was very helpful and let us try every type before buying.

This sourdough shop is my absolute favorite.
The familiar taste is amazing, and it's hard to find really delicious sourdough that I love. When I found this shop, I had to bookmark it!

This sourdough has a soft, not dense, texture. It's the first time I've tried this type of sourdough, and I found it delicious and perfectly suited to my taste. It's easy to eat and easy to bake – the least fussy sourdough I've ever had; it bakes quickly, heats up fast, and crisps perfectly. The shop owner is so lovely and friendly, and gave me a tip on how to reheat it: the aroma from the oven means it's perfect, and it was! 👍 No need to time it. Thank you so much to the shop! 🙏 I'll definitely be a repeat customer.
